title: 第17章 挑衅第18章 反杀
slug: 我在修仙界竟然苟成大佬
content_zh:
眼见李倩儿又要出手，张丰一咬牙，从怀中掏出一沓符箓——这可是他平日里当宝贝供着的保命符，都是秦梦涵随手赏赐的。
虽说对秦梦涵来说不过是些小玩意儿，但在他这儿可都是压箱底的宝贝。
娘的，舍不得孩子套不着狼！
张丰肉疼地往符箓里注入灵力，一甩手朝李倩儿扔去。
霎时间火光四起，烟尘漫天。
这符箓虽伤不了李倩儿分毫，但胜在声势浩大，果然让她身形一顿。
快走！
张丰喊了一句，两人脚底抹油，一溜烟跑得没影儿。
稍矮男子边跑边回头张望，心里暗想：这张丰，当真是个狠角色...以后可得防着点。
张丰灰头土脸地逃回宗门后，眼珠子一转，立刻一瘸一拐地跑去寻秦梦涵告状。
他捂着胸口，脸上挂着三分痛楚七分委屈，把整件事说得活灵活现——自然，在他的版本里，李倩儿成了蛮横无理、恃强凌弱的恶人，而他们几个则是忠心为主却惨遭毒打的忠仆。
秦师姐，您可要为我们做主啊！
张丰声泪俱下，还不忘适时地咳嗽两声，那李倩儿分明是知道我们是您的人，还故意...
秦梦涵斜倚在软榻上，纤纤玉指把玩着一缕青丝。
待他说完，她突然冷笑一声：办事不利还敢来邀功？玉手一挥，几个膀大腰圆的杂役弟子立刻上前，当着众人的面把张丰按在地上结结实实地揍了一顿。
啊！
秦师姐饶命啊！
张丰疼得龇牙咧嘴，心里却暗骂自己多此一举。
不过这事秦梦涵也认为是李倩儿不知好歹，不把自己放眼里，于是派人去寻李倩儿的麻烦。
可惜李倩儿早就料到这一出，在他们找来时刚好当着守阁长老面接了个宗门紧急任务，和金丹长老一起出任务，秦梦涵知道后气得摔了茶盏，那张俏脸阴沉得能滴出水来。

好个李倩儿，竟敢不把本小姐放在眼里！
她咬牙切齿道。
可一查宗门记录，李倩儿确实接了外出任务，行踪成谜。
秦梦涵虽然气得牙痒痒，却也无可奈何，只得暂时把这笔账记在心里。
暂且让她逍遥几日。
秦梦涵冷哼一声，转身离去。
张丰趴在地上，望着师姐远去的背影，心里五味杂陈——这顿打挨得，可真不值当！
随即又怨恨的骂道“都是李倩儿，等着，我绝对不会放过你！”
回忆起那段不堪往事，张丰眼中闪过一丝阴狠，屈辱感如毒蛇般啃噬着他的心脏。
他不再犹豫，冷笑一声道：也罢。
转头看向宁知初时，目光已如看一个死人，道友得罪了，来世——他故意拖长声调，记得投个好胎。
话音未落，便与同伴同时暴起发难。
宁知初见状不由一怔，心中暗叫：我去！
content_en:
Seeing that Li Qian'er was about to take action again, Zhang Feng gritted his teeth and took out a stack of talismans from his arms - these were the life-saving talismans that he usually kept as treasures, and they were all casually gifted by Qin Menghan.
Although they are just gadgets to Qin Menghan, to him they are top-notch treasures.
Damn it, I can’t bear to let the child catch the wolf!
Zhang Feng painfully poured spiritual power into the talisman and threw it towards Li Qian'er.
In an instant, flames burst out and smoke filled the sky.
Although this talisman could not hurt Li Qian'er at all, it was more powerful than it was, and it really stunned her body.
Go quickly!
Zhang Feng shouted, the two of them greased their feet and ran away without a trace.
The slightly shorter man looked back while running, thinking to himself: Zhang Feng is really a ruthless character... I have to be more careful in the future.
After Zhang Feng fled back to the sect in disgrace, he rolled his eyes and immediately limped to find Qin Menghan to complain.
He clutched his chest, with a look of pain and grievance on his face, and told the whole thing vividly - naturally, in his version, Li Qian'er became an unreasonable and bullying villain, while they were loyal servants who were loyal to the Lord but were brutally beaten.
Senior Sister Qin, you have to make the decision for us!
Zhang Feng burst into tears and coughed twice at the right time. Li Qian'er clearly knew that we were yours and deliberately...
Qin Menghan was leaning on the soft couch, playing with a strand of black hair with her slender jade fingers.
After he finished speaking, she suddenly sneered: How dare you take credit for your failure? With a wave of his hand, several fat and round servant disciples immediately stepped forward, pushed Zhang Feng to the ground and gave him a good beating in front of everyone.
ah!
Senior Sister Qin, please spare your life!
Zhang Feng grimaced in pain, but secretly cursed himself for unnecessary actions.
However, Qin Menghan also thought that Li Qian'er was ignorant and did not take him seriously, so he sent people to find trouble for Li Qian'er.
It's a pity that Li Qian'er had expected this, and when they came to find her, she happened to take on an urgent mission from the sect in front of the elders guarding the pavilion, and went on a mission with elder Jin Dan. When Qin Menghan found out, he was so angry that he dropped the teacup, and his pretty face was so gloomy that water dripped from his face.
What a good Li Qianer, how dare you not take this lady seriously!
She gritted her teeth.
But after checking the sect records, it was found that Li Qian'er had indeed taken on the mission, and her whereabouts were a mystery.
Although Qin Menghan was so angry that he had no choice but to keep this account in mind for the time being.
Let her relax for a few days.
Qin Menghan snorted coldly, turned and left.
Zhang Feng lay on the ground, looking at the retreating figure of his senior sister, with mixed feelings in his heart - this beating was really not worth it!
Then he cursed resentfully, "It's all Li Qian'er, wait, I will never let you go!"
Recalling that unbearable past, Zhang Feng's eyes flashed with a hint of viciousness, and the sense of humiliation gnawed at his heart like a poisonous snake.
He no longer hesitated and sneered: "That's fine."
When he turned to look at Ning Zhichu, his eyes were like looking at a dead person. Fellow Taoist was offended. In the next life - he deliberately prolonged his voice, remembering to cast a good fetus.
Before he could even finish his words, he and his companions burst into revolt at the same time.
Ning Zhi couldn't help but be startled when he saw this for the first time, and secretly shouted in his heart: I'm going!
